selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the first picture used in this passage?
questions.answer: A huge hidden tree.

questions.question: Why must a tree and its parts match one another?
questions.answer: Because each part belongs to the same tree.

questions.question: What kind of work does the person in the example do over the covering?
questions.answer: He draws the hidden tree’s parts in the right way.

questions.question: If someone draws the hidden tree correctly without seeing it, what does that show?
questions.answer: That he knows the tree very well and sees beyond the covering.

questions.question: What is the Qur’an compared to in relation to creation?
questions.answer: Like someone showing the shape of a hidden tree.

questions.question: What image is used for creation itself?
questions.answer: A tree.

questions.question: How did careful scholars react to this?
questions.answer: They were amazed and praised Allah.

questions.question: What did searching scholars say after studying these descriptions?
questions.answer: They said Allah’s wonders and blessings are great.

questions.question: What honor did they give the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They said it explains the universe’s riddle.

questions.question: What living thing is used as an example at the start?
questions.answer: A very large tree.

questions.question: What would a correct drawing include?
questions.answer: The right shape of every part.

questions.question: If someone outlines the hidden tree exactly, what ability does he seem to have?
questions.answer: He seems able to know what cannot be seen.

questions.question: What does the passage call all created things together?
questions.answer: A tree of creation.

questions.question: What far places are named to show its greatness?
questions.answer: From earth up to the divine throne.

questions.question: What hidden thing are we asked to imagine first?
questions.answer: A strange, enormous tree.

questions.question: What must be true about the tree’s leaves, fruit, and branches?
questions.answer: They must match the whole tree.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Qur’an does with all parts of creation?
questions.answer: It describes them in the right measure and shape.

questions.question: What example helps explain the Qur’an in this passage?
questions.answer: The example of a hidden tree and a person drawing it.

questions.question: What does the passage call creation in this example?
questions.answer: A tree of creation.

questions.question: What was the response of scholars who looked deeply into this?
questions.answer: They were amazed and praised Allah.

questions.question: What big object are we told to imagine under a covering?
questions.answer: A giant unusual tree.

questions.question: What picture comes first in the passage to help us think?
questions.answer: A hidden giant tree.

questions.question: What unseen truth is especially talked about next?
questions.answer: The truth of all creation.

questions.question: How well does the Qur’an keep the parts of creation together in its description?
questions.answer: Very well, with exact balance.

title: Description of Creation's Reality Through the Tree Parable
